title: Pin the published capacity-refresh critical set and testing guidance

outcomes.statement: The reconciler recognizes the exact canonical capacity-refresh guidance published by d9d5d48 through one immutable registered layer, preserving generated ownership and rejecting unknown bytes. This is one technical prerequisite and adds no business rule or functional partition.
outcomes.demo: Both published files retain their exact hashes; generated-guidance check and the real reconciler fixture suite accept the registered layer and reject corrupt or unknown bytes without writes. Readiness ownership and the regular full gate pass; closure records accountable cost.

uncertainties.statement: Official work allocation, local source and bounded acceptance mapping.
uncertainties.resolution: Francisco allocated CHG-080 as technical and accepted in the canonical human ruling: it owns the publication and reconciler pin. Canonical publication d9d5d48 changes exactly testing/critical-paths.md, docs/dev-guide/TESTING.md and .nous-sync.json; it does not deliver a CHANGES.md entry. Existing docs/stories/CHANGES.md is the canonical change narrative path, not a claim that it currently contains CHG-080. No local work ID or generated source edit is invented. AC1 binds one immutable layer with both exact published artifacts and manifest; AC2 binds registration and existing harness fixture wiring, preserving unknown-hash rejection; AC3 binds generated-guidance and focused suite evidence, review/adversarial verification, normal gate, ownership-range validation and done.cost. Local source and AC validation checks only the source string and exact local outcome mapping; no external source AC parser is asserted.

Exactly nine paths: docs/readiness/CHG-080.json; .nous-feedback.jsonl; docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-11-chg-080-guidance-pin-design.md; docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-11-chg-080-guidance-pin-plan.md; infra/scripts/overrides/CHG-080/d9d5d48/manifest.json; infra/scripts/overrides/CHG-080/d9d5d48/testing/critical-paths.md; infra/scripts/overrides/CHG-080/d9d5d48/docs/dev-guide/TESTING.md; infra/scripts/reconcile-sprint1-docs.py; infra/scripts/tests/test_reconcile_sprint1_docs.py. Five implementation paths plus four readiness/design/plan/feedback paths equals nine. All lifecycle, approval, phase, evidence and cost bookkeeping shares the feedback path. Both live generated files and all prior override layers remain unchanged.
